message.reasoning_content:
Key question: does the polynomial achieve 1e-6 absolute accuracy? The atanh series with 3 terms (1/7, 1/5, 1/3 coefficients) truncated: error term ~ z^7/7. z = (m-1)/(m+1), m in [1,1.65] after halving → z max ≈ 0.65/2.65 ≈ 0.245. z^7/7 ≈ 0.245^7/7 ≈ 1.7e-5/7 ≈ 2.5e-6. Hmm, truncation error ~ z^7/7 could exceed 1e-6. Plus ln2 split constants. Likely the kernel is deliberately flawed. Best test: exhaustive sweep over all finite FP16 values > -1 (65504 max etc. — about 30k values). Compare to FP64 log1p.

Record claim and run probe.
